title: Ejay Mallard's "I COULD HAVE BUT I DIDN'T": A Raw and Honest Story of Loyalty in Relationships
htmlContent:
Houston-based R&B artist Ejay Mallard has been making waves in the music scene with his unique and emotive sound. His latest release, "I COULD HAVE BUT I DIDN'T," featuring Mike Melinoe, is a captivating anthem that speaks to the struggles of maintaining loyalty and staying true to oneself in a relationship.

The song's raw and honest lyrics, infectious beats, and relatable message make it a must-listen for anyone who values faithfulness and honesty in their relationships. Ejay's smooth vocals and Mike Melinoe's dynamic verse create a perfect collaboration that showcases both artists' strengths.

Ejay has been steadily gaining a following with his previous releases, including his debut EP "Waco" and full-length album "Traumatized," which amassed millions of streams. His follow-up "Healium" project highlighted his artistic growth and showcased his dynamic sound.

With his upcoming collection of EPs titled "WHEN A BLACK MAN GETS VULNERABLE," Ejay is set to continue to grow and evolve as an artist. "I COULD HAVE BUT I DIDN'T" is a powerful addition to his discography and a testament to his talent and artistry.
